title: He Rejoices Over You
question: How does God feel about His people, in His own words?
blurb: A prophet of judgment ends with singing. See what Scripture says God delights in.

nodes.content: How does God feel about His people, in His own words?

nodes.verseText: The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will rejoice over you with singing.”
Be strong and courageous; do not be afraid or terrified of them, for it is the LORD your God who goes with you; He will never leave you nor forsake you.”
For as a young man marries a young woman, so your sons will marry you; and as a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so your God will rejoice over you.
The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him, who hope in His loving devotion.
I tell you that in the same way there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous ones who do not need to repent.
